nodes.label: Staff UI Shell
nodes.rationale: staff_page_start/staff_page_end with per-role nav; relative asset paths depend on a repeated folder regex (ADMIN|RETAIL|INVENTORY|CASHIER|courier) that a new role folder must be added to.

nodes.label: API Response Convention (200 {ok:false} for business rejections)
nodes.norm_label: api response convention (200 {ok:false} for business rejections)
nodes.rationale: Business rejections return HTTP 200 {ok:false,error,message}; 4xx only for auth/method/CSRF because 4xx fetches show as browser console errors; CSRF token in JSON body.

nodes.label: Role-per-folder Modules
nodes.rationale: login.php redirectByRole() sends each role to its folder: ADMIN, RETAIL, INVENTORY, CASHIER, CLIENT. SELLER/courier referenced but absent; technician role removed.

nodes.label: Payment Methods (Cash/GCash/Maya/Card)
nodes.rationale: Non-cash requires reference no.; no split payments.

nodes.label: Stale MySQL Schema Dumps
nodes.rationale: database/schema.sql, techprime_ai.sql and most migration_*.sql are outdated phpMyAdmin dumps; not the real schema.

nodes.label: Supabase Pooler Port 6543 (transaction pooling)
nodes.rationale: Keep work inside one transaction; never use session-level SET since it can leak to other clients.

nodes.label: Supabase PostgreSQL (live shared DB)
nodes.rationale: Only one database, live and shared; migrations run by hand; ask before schema change or data write.

nodes.label: TechPrime AI System
nodes.rationale: Capstone inventory/e-commerce system for EasyPC One Oasis Branch; plain PHP 8.2 on XAMPP, code is source of truth over planning docs (Next.js/FastAPI/Supabase).

nodes.label: Generated In-store Barcodes (21 + product id + check digit)
nodes.norm_label: generated in-store barcodes (21 + product id + check digit)
nodes.rationale: Unique, in GS1 restricted range, distinct from 20... test codes.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Supabase Password in includes/db.php
nodes.rationale: Committed and on GitHub; DB password needs rotation; deleting the unused file needs user OK.

nodes.label: Live Test Data (test cashier #62, test barcodes, INV-20260926-000004)
nodes.norm_label: live test data (test cashier #62, test barcodes, inv-20260926-000004)

nodes.label: Pending Physical Scanner + Printer Test
nodes.rationale: Scanner was only simulated; print labels at 100% scale; scanner must send Enter suffix.

nodes.label: Void Sale with Store Manager Approval (not started)
nodes.norm_label: void sale with store manager approval (not started)

nodes.label: Cashier Role + Barcode POS Handoff
nodes.rationale: Add a Cashier role using a USB 1D barcode scanner for checkout (stock-out) and receiving (stock-in), UI matching custodian pages; panel asked for invoicing and low/critical-stock monitoring.

nodes.label: Plain PHP 8.2 / XAMPP Stack (no framework)
nodes.rationale: No framework, no build step; do not introduce a new stack.

nodes.label: Project Rules (ask before delete/deps/DB writes)
nodes.rationale: Stop and ask before deleting files, adding dependencies, writing to the live DB, or changing role behavior; never touch .env; reuse existing helpers; match existing staff UI; keep scratch output out of the web root.

nodes.label: No New Dependencies (own scanner + SVG renderer)
nodes.norm_label: no new dependencies (own scanner + svg renderer)
nodes.rationale: User rule: ask before adding dependencies, so scanner module and barcode renderer were written in-house.

nodes.label: Invoice Numbering (pos_invoice_seq)
nodes.rationale: Sequences are not transactional: invoice numbers 1-3 consumed by rolled-back tests; tests swap the invoice_no default inside the rolled-back transaction to avoid burning real numbers.

nodes.label: Receipt: THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL RECEIPT
nodes.norm_label: receipt: this is not an official receipt
nodes.rationale: No BIR POS accreditation; receipt prints on 80 mm and A4.

nodes.label: pos_sales / pos_sale_items Tables
nodes.rationale: Invoice INV-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN from pos_invoice_seq; client_ref UUID unique; RLS enabled.

nodes.label: Rolled-back Transaction Testing
nodes.rationale: Since only the live DB exists, DB logic is tested inside a transaction that is rolled back; helpers use SAVEPOINTs when nested; forced failures via triggers created in the same transaction.

nodes.label: Manual Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: No automated tests: php -l, rolled-back DB scripts, curl access-control checks with cookie jar, headless browser via browser-automation skill.

nodes.label: Checkout Integrity Design
nodes.rationale: Lock rows FOR UPDATE ORDER BY id to avoid deadlocks, re-check stock, DB prices only, guarded UPDATE WHERE stock >= ?, client_ref idempotency, notifications after commit, SAVEPOINT when nested.

nodes.label: FK ON DELETE SET NULL + Name Snapshots
nodes.norm_label: fk on delete set null + name snapshots
nodes.rationale: Admin can still delete users and custodian can still delete products without breaking sales/movement history.

nodes.label: Barcode Normalization (EAN-8 / 13-digit GTIN)
nodes.rationale: EAN-8 stored as 8 digits; UPC-A/UPC-E/EAN-13 as 13-digit GTIN so the same item matches whether scanner sends 12 or 13 digits.

nodes.label: PHP Heredoc JS Interpolation Gotcha
nodes.rationale: $ and \n are interpolated in heredoc-built scripts; use nowdoc or escape.

nodes.label: POST-Redirect-GET Page Pattern
nodes.rationale: POST handlers at top then redirect with ?alert=; GET renders server-side and embeds JSON for client-side filtering/paging.

nodes.label: Separate products.barcode Column (not sku)
nodes.rationale: All 261 sku values are internal MSKU codes; no UPC/EAN existed in the catalog.

nodes.label: Unreachable Critical Branch in inv_notify_stock_change
nodes.rationale: ok->low/critical branch matches first so ok->critical says 'low in stock'; 12 h dedupe uses LIKE on product name and can suppress alerts.

nodes.label: Session Auth & Role Guards
nodes.rationale: Every page calls checkSessionTimeout() (15 min) and checkRole(); JSON endpoints check $_SESSION['role'] and return {ok:false,error} with 403; CSRF tokens; h() escaping.
